況.meaning: <part>Big brother</part> is babysitting, and the bath overflows: <part>water drops</part> on the stairs, toys floating down the hall, the cat paddling past. Mum phones: 'How's the house?' He looks around. 'The <kanji>condition</kanji> is... wet.'
況.on: Mum is phoning from a temple in <sound>Kyo</sound>to, and he stalls by stretching out the start of the city's name while he mops.
況.kun: '<sound>Ma</sound>'s home, and she hasn't even seen the <sound>shee</sound>ts yet, let alone the cat.

借.meaning: You hang your coat on a <part>coat hook</part> in a museum of <part>antiquity</part>. When you come back, it's gone: an old marble statue is wearing it. Next day it's back on the hook with a thank-you note in old Latin. The statue only wanted to <kanji>borrow</kanji> it.
借.on: The note is signed with a tiny drawing of a <sound>sha</sound>rk.
借.kun: The next week, the statue asks for the keys to your <sound>ca</sound>r.

駆.meaning: A <part>horse</part> takes the night shift as a taxi in the busiest <part>ward</part> of the city. Passengers hop on its back, and it thunders down the high street, round buses and past the flower stalls. It never stops for anything: watch it <kanji>drive</kanji>.
駆.on: A <sound>cu</sound>ckoo rides on its head, calling out the stops.
駆.kun: <sound>Ca</sound>rs pull over to the side to let it gallop past.

劇.meaning: At the zoo's talent night, a <part>tiger</part> and a <part>pig</part> put on a play. The pig waves a rubber <part>dagger</part>, the tiger faints, the pig weeps, the tiger sits up for a bow. The penguins sob into their flippers. What a <kanji>drama</kanji>.
劇.on: The whole show is directed by a <sound>gec</sound>ko in a beret, clinging to the curtain.

企.meaning: At the bus <part>stop</part>, a girl opens her <part>umbrella</part> and announces she'll sell umbrellas to everyone waiting in the rain. By the next bus she's sold forty and hired her grandad. That's a bold business to <kanji>undertake</kanji>.
企.on: She keeps the cash in a tin locked with a big brass <sound>key</sound>.
企.kun: Her grandad's <sound>cu</sound>ckoo clock squawks '<sound>Wah</sound>!' while she draws the next plan on a <sound>da</sound>rtboard.

協.meaning: A whale is stuck on the beach. <part>Ten</part> <part>strongmen</part> grab a rope each, count to three and heave together: one grunt, one pull, and it slides back into the sea. Nobody could have done it alone. It takes <kanji>cooperation</kanji>.
協.on: To keep in time, the ten strongmen chant '<sound>Kyo</sound>to!' on every heave, all holding the start long together until the whale slides free.
